nodes.spirit: Compression is the beginning of flight.

nodes.kata: 30s continuous hold, legs parallel to floor, arms fully locked, hips not sagging, on parallettes or floor, 90s rest
nodes.spirit: Compression so complete the body forgets gravity briefly.
nodes.emomKata: every 2 min × 3: 30s hold, legs parallel to floor, arms fully locked, hips not sagging, on parallettes or floor

nodes.kata: 3×20s hold, legs at 75°, arms locked, full scapular depression, 75s rest
nodes.spirit: Three quarters of the way to parallel.
nodes.emomKata: every 90s × 3: 20s hold, rest remaining

nodes.kata: 3×15s hold, legs at 135°, compression extreme, arms locked, 90s rest
nodes.spirit: Past parallel. Into compression.
nodes.emomKata: every 105s × 3: 15s hold, rest remaining

nodes.kata: 3×20s hold, legs at 45°, arms locked, scapulae depressed, 75s rest
nodes.spirit: Below parallel. Not yet there. Already hard.
nodes.emomKata: every 90s × 3: 20s hold, rest remaining

nodes.kata: 8s continuous manna hold, hips above shoulders, legs extended forward, arms behind pressing down, 120s rest
nodes.spirit: The highest compression. The rarest posture. The manna does not negotiate.
nodes.emomKata: every 2 min × 3: 8s hold, hips above shoulders, legs extended forward, arms behind pressing down

nodes.kata: 3×10 each leg, in L sit position, alternate leg flutter, arms locked throughout, 90s rest
nodes.spirit: The L sits still. The legs argue between themselves.
nodes.emomKata: every 2 min × 3: 10 reps each side, in L sit position, alternate leg flutter, arms locked throughout

nodes.kata: 10s continuous human flag hold each side, body fully horizontal, arms locked, no sag at hips, 120s rest
nodes.spirit: The body writes itself horizontally against the sky.
nodes.emomKata: every 2.5 min × 3: 10s hold each side, body fully horizontal, arms locked, no sag at hips

nodes.kata: 3×8s hold each side, knees tucked, body horizontal on pole, arms locked, 90s rest
nodes.spirit: The flag begins tucked. Everything does.
nodes.emomKata: every 105s × 3: 8s hold each side, rest remaining

nodes.kata: 8s vertical flag hold each side, body fully vertical on pole, arms locked, 120s rest
nodes.spirit: Not horizontal. Vertical. The sky is different from up here.
nodes.emomKata: every 2.5 min × 3: 8s hold each side, body fully vertical on pole, arms locked

nodes.kata: 3×12 each side, dead hang, oblique-driven knee raise, knees to elbow, controlled descent, 75s rest
nodes.spirit: The hang. The twist. The raise. Three in one.
nodes.emomKata: every 105s × 3: 12 reps each side, dead hang, oblique-driven knee raise, knees to elbow, controlled descent

nodes.kata: 3×60s each side, body rigid, hips stacked, no rotation, breathing steady, 60s rest
nodes.spirit: The side. The forgotten face of the plank.
nodes.emomKata: every 3 min × 3: 60s hold each side, body rigid, hips stacked, no rotation

nodes.kata: 3x30s hold each side, from side plank, top arm and top leg fully extended, body rigid, no hip sag, 75s rest
nodes.spirit: The star does not collapse at the edges.
nodes.emomKata: every 2 min × 3: 30s hold each side, rest remaining

nodes.spirit: The twist precedes the strike.

nodes.kata: 3×15 each side, lateral flexion over bench or chair, full range, 3s negative, 60s rest
nodes.spirit: The side bends. The spine strengthens.
nodes.emomKata: every 2 min × 3: 15 reps each side, lateral flexion over bench or chair, full range, 3s negative

nodes.kata: 3×30s each side, top leg on elevated surface, full body rigid, 75s rest
nodes.spirit: Copenhagen asks more of the side than any other variation.
nodes.emomKata: every 2.5 min × 3: 30s hold each side, top leg on elevated surface, full body rigid

nodes.kata: 3×12 each side, from side plank, raise top leg to hip height, controlled return, 60s rest
nodes.spirit: The plank moves. The core does not.
nodes.emomKata: every 90s × 3: 12 reps each side, from side plank, raise top leg to hip height, controlled return

nodes.kata: 3×10 each direction, hanging from bar, legs straight, sweep full arc, controlled throughout, 90s rest
nodes.spirit: The wiper knows every angle.
nodes.emomKata: every 2 min × 3: 10 reps, each direction, hanging from bar, legs straight, sweep full arc, controlled throughout
